items.title: PwnEscape: Guest-to-Host KVM Escape (CVE-2026-99999)
items.blurb: How a $1 million sandbox challenge led pwn to a Linux CHECKSUM_PARTIAL trust-boundary bug: a post-validation IPv4 header mutation, a 32-byte host-memory disclosure, and a reliable full host VM escape.
